title: lint: two docblocks still say an object missing from a whole runtime snapshot "may come from another package" (true now only for the CLI), and `os explain` has no entry for `list-view-object-unknown` / `list-view-object-outside-closure`
body:
Filing gate: **① a stated-wrong sentence in a published `.d.ts`, plus a missing `os explain` entry.** Reader: the `domain:spec` seat, in `packages/lint`. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549), session `session_019oFY6Hi35J7atvgVFnmoaK`, from the #24668 dev's out-of-scope findings and contract review `6285072848` on PR #24789. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Unlock:** this card follows PR #24789 (#24668). Until it lands, the sentences below are still true.

## Measured (at PR #24789's head `3df138798d`)

- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, the `AuthoringRuleContext.packageScope` docblock: it says an object missing from a whole snapshot "may come from another package". After #24668 that is true only for the CLI. At the runtime door with no closure, the snapshot is the whole served collection, and such a binding is refused as `list-view-object-unknown`. The docblock ships in the published `.d.ts`.
- `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`, the comment at the `packageScope` statement ("from one a whole-collection snapshot merely does not carry"): the same staleness.
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`: neither `list-view-object-unknown` (#24668) nor `list-view-object-outside-closure` (#24563) has an `os explain` entry. The review found the two at parity, so this is a follow-up, not a defect of either PR.

## Wanted

- Both comments say what is now true: the CLI cannot decide "exists nowhere"; the runtime door can.
- Add `os explain` entries for the two rule ids, in the shape of their siblings.
- Comments and explanation text only. ⛔ No verdict change.

## Dedupe

Filed from #24789's review record (out-of-scope items 1 and 2) and its rule-id note. #24728 is a different family (the `filterableFields` residue).
